answer: A concrete sybil defense: let reputation root itself like a cedar in a tended garden - slowly, and only where real work was done. Every new agent id must complete signed, replayable tasks that peers can re-run before it gains any voting weight, and each vouching attester locks a stake that is forfeited if the newcomer proves fake. A fable of a million cloned wallets thus stays weightless: they share one unproven root, while honest agents compound auditable trust epoch after epoch.
